SELECT q.id, q.quote_raw, q.emotion_retry_count, b.title, b.author
FROM quotes q
JOIN books b ON b.id = q.book_id
WHERE b.aladin_status = 'validated'
  AND q.quote_check_status = 'validated'
  AND q.emotion_status IN ('staged', 'retry_wait')
  AND q.emotion_next_retry_at <= NOW()
ORDER BY q.emotion_next_retry_at, q.id
LIMIT 10;

UPDATE quotes
SET emotion_status = '{{ $json.emotion_status }}',
    emotion_retry_count = {{ $json.emotion_retry_count || 0 }},
    emotion_next_retry_at = '{{ $json.emotion_next_retry_at }}'::timestamp,
    emotion_error_reason = {{ $json.emotion_error_reason ? "'" + $json.emotion_error_reason.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    emotion_model = {{ $json.emotion_model ? "'" + $json.emotion_model.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    emotion_valence = {{ $json.emotion_valence ? "'" + $json.emotion_valence.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
    emotion_candidates = {{ "'" + JSON.stringify($json.emotion_candidates || []).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::jsonb" }},
    situation_tags = {{ ($json.situation_tags || []).length ? 'ARRAY[' + $json.situation_tags.map(tag => "'" + tag.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') + ']::TEXT[]' : 'ARRAY[]::TEXT[]' }},
    purpose_tags = {{ ($json.purpose_tags || []).length ? 'ARRAY[' + $json.purpose_tags.map(tag => "'" + tag.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'").join(',') + ']::TEXT[]' : 'ARRAY[]::TEXT[]' }},
    classified_at = {{ $json.classified_at ? "'" + $json.classified_at + "'::timestamp" : 'classified_at' }}
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};
